summary_md: **NVK ([@nvk](https://x.com/nvk/status/2115567404403298516))** writes up running **Codex on DeepSeek V4 (DS4) locally on an M5 Max** at about 35 tok/s, with an emphasis on not leaking the host environment to the agent; the article links a step-by-step guide on learntoprompt.org.
relevance: Concrete recipe for pointing a mainstream coding harness at a local max-tier model while sandboxing it.
